# muxt documentation prints embedded docs and an index

muxt documentation
stdout '^reference$'
stdout '^  template-names — Template Name Syntax$'
stdout '^  commands/generate — '
stdout '^how-to$'
stdout 'muxt documentation <topic>'
stdout 'relative to the muxt repository'

muxt documentation docs/reference/template-names.md
stdout '^# Template Name Syntax$'

muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/generate.md
stdout '^# muxt generate'

muxt documentation --format json
stdout '"id": "call-parameters"'
stdout '"section": "reference"'

muxt help documentation
stdout 'documentation'

muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/check.md
stdout '^# muxt check'
